text:
olivia: Quick async check — v2 rollout milestone next week. Need clear owners for the final cutover window, SDK blockers, and the feature-flag gating plan. Current draft: feature-freeze Tue 09:00 UTC, canary Wed 16:00 UTC (small region), global cutover Fri 02:00 UTC. Any blocker calls?
ashok: +1 on dates. I'll own runtime routing and can take the canary monitoring dashboards. Will add smoke queries to the dashboard by EOD.
maria: Working on the SDK header/backcompat patch. Expect PR by EOD today — github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/4831. The change keeps legacy X-Client-Version for one extra release behind a guard flag.
kevin: Heads-up: some downstream UI clients still rely on legacy 401 handling and the removed /v1/compat header. @maria can we ship a compatibility shim for one release? That buys time for mobile teams. :pray:
mar ia: (typo) sorry meant @maria — can confirm mobile will need 48–72hrs to validate after your PR lands.
lena: On telemetry — we need a KV-cache hit-rate check during canary. @ashok can you wire a short-lived metric: inference.kv_cache.hit_ratio per model?
ashok: Yep. I'll add a metric and a 5m alert if hit_ratio drops >10% from baseline.
sre-oncall: Reminder: we'll need fallback routing policy configured before canary (route to smaller quantized model on overload). I'll coordinate with infra to carve capacity.
devops-bot: Deploy checklist created: /deploys/v2-rollout/1711112222 — steps: freeze, canary, smoke, promote. Automated smoke runs: test-suite/canary-smoke.
olivia: Quick ask for SDK owners: prioritize the header shim and one integration test for 401 handling. If PR lands by EOD tomorrow we can keep canary Wed. Otherwise we shift canary 24h.
maria: PR drafted, adding integration test. Tagging @kevin for validation.
kevin: Will run a quick validation against staging mobile build tomorrow morning. If I see regressions I’ll ping here with exact failing endpoints.
olivia: Owners summary: runtime routing -> ashok; sdk/backcompat -> maria; telemetry + alerts -> lena + ashok; fallback + capacity -> sre-oncall. If anyone can't take ownership, speak up now.
lena: I can own telemetry dashboard and alerts. I'll post links when ready. :rocket:
kevin: Small note — we should add a CLI toggle for devs to opt into v2 locally: in rdwctl add --api-version=v2. I can raise a tiny PR after mobile validation.
ashok: I added a minimal example for the rollout-bot:
```
# feature flag gating example
POST /api/flags/update
{
  "flag": "v2_cutover",
  "action": "gradual",
  "targets": ["canary-region-1"],
  "rollout_pct": 10
}
```
mar ia: (again) sorry for the typos — mobile team asked if we can run a short compatibility window where /v1 endpoints respond with an X-Compat-Mode header for 48h. Is that feasible?
sre-oncall: Feasible if we enable shim on ingress layer and monitor error-rate. I'll schedule the change and rollback playbook in runbook.
olivia: Great. Plan of action: 1) Maria lands SDK patch + integration test (EOD tomorrow). 2) Ashok lands metric + alert (EOD). 3) SRE wires fallback routing + ingress shim (before canary). 4) Kevin validates mobile (morning after PR). 5) Lena posts telemetry dashboard link when ready. If all on time — canary Wed. If any major slip, we shift canary 24h.
kevin: Acknowledge. I'll ping mobile leads once PR is up.
maria: Acknowledged. Tagging PR with changelog and compatibility note.
olivia: Thanks everyone — will consolidate owners + timeline in the migration playbook page and tag this thread. :white_check_mark:
